scope: Current Mist CN print/numbering/root wiring; read-only review and temporary fixture tests only

checks.finding: Allocates with original nextBusinessNumber from one current database transaction, scans all retained workspace facts and existing professional records, CLM case/CN share pool; no UUID fallback.
Sequence participates in existing serialized clone/atomic rename transaction; corrupt sequence rejected and positive increments only.
Fresh owner/scope check, durable receipt and optimistic revision checks precede number preparation and PDF rendering; permission checked again before commit.
Issue adds private file metadata and immutable print version only; it does not recalculate financial amount/settlement or write goods/inventory.
Client accepts IDs only; source validates exact Executed approved disposition, reviewer/decision fields, frozen attachments, original CI and configured issuer.
Selected print version belongs to credit and source, snapshot/source/hash/file metadata verified; archived bytes read without live re-render.
Both CN routes use Buffer.from(document.bytes), with application/pdf, no-store, nosniff and SHA header; real local clone HTTP regression included.
Preview uses source version and download uses exact print version; PDF magic checked and identity/workspace epoch rechecked after download.

limitations: No product code changed during this review.
Tests use explicit in-memory/temporary local fixtures and mocked PDF renderer; actual UI-downloaded PDF visual/readback evidence is recorded separately.
No actual company edit was performed; immutable issuer archive after company changes is repository test coverage.
No real PostgreSQL concurrency or multi-process local-file runtime test was run.
